verificationSummary: Editor merge commit 5f7b0c0064b4a6d70bdc2d121138dd3fae7aba12 adds bounded text-block insert-to-edit handoff readiness. The Editor now resolves an applied text-block.insert Backend mutation result into a ready text editor focus target only when the selected node is one of the returned targetNodeIds and the returned package/document pair advertises text-block.rich-inline.replace. notifyTextBlockInsertToEditTarget emits the ready canvasFocusNodeId/textBlockId to EditorApp, which reuses the existing canvas focus path so a ready inserted text block can focus the bounded textarea surface. textBlockInlineDraftAdapter now accepts Core document v4 canonical empty text blocks as children: [] clean drafts and creates the first text run only when non-empty text is entered through the existing bounded textarea path; invalid empty text inline leaves remain outside the fixture. RED evidence included an initial discarded fixture correction after Core rejected an empty text leaf, then npm run test -- src/tests/activeTextBlockInsertToEdit.test.ts failed because resolveTextBlockInsertToEditTarget was not a function. GREEN evidence passed npm run test -- src/tests/activeTextBlockInsertToEdit.test.ts with 3 tests; npm run test -- src/tests/addNodeVisibleActions.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockInsertToEdit.test.ts src/tests/activeTextBlockEditingHook.test.ts src/tests/textBlockInlineDraftAdapter.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts with 5 files and 23 tests; npm run type-check; npm run check in the Editor worktree with 103 test files, 370 tests, and build; and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke. Merged Editor main passed the same focused 5-file/23-test gate, npm run check with 103 test files, 370 tests, and build, followed by FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke with final Outline order editor-text-block-zone-cover-body-1 > title > editor-columns-zone-cover-body-2 > summary-columns > summary-left-text > summary-right-text > detail-table > detail-cell-a-text > detail-cell-b-text. Project Control baseline npm run check passed before record edits. Project Control RED evidence passed by failing npx vitest run tests/project-roadmap-work-queue.test.ts --reporter verbose before this phase/evidence was registered. This evidence is Editor-side handoff readiness only: current Backend add-node transport remains bounded to package 2/document 3, and Core/Backend document v4 insert semantics remain unsupported, so it does not prove that the currently visible add Text flow can immediately enter editable text on the live route. This evidence does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, Columns editing, Table editing, exact table cell editing UI, exact column layout editing UI, arbitrary rich-inline authoring beyond the existing bounded textarea path, field-ref chip editing, delete-on-cancel policy, durable drafts, collaboration, cross-browser focus readiness, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, full large-document authoring performance readiness, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. Editor npm install still reports 5 high severity audit findings and Vite retains the existing chunk-size warning.
